parameters.help_zh: 任务ID。在呼叫任务管理界面查看任务ID或通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2926799.html接口获取任务ID

parameters.help_en: The detail ID. You can find this ID in the upper-left corner of the page by navigating to call task management > details > execution history > completed > call details, or get it by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2926853.html operation
parameters.help_zh: 任务明细ID。在呼叫任务管理>详情>执行记录>已完成>通话详情界面左上角查看任务明细ID或通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2926853.html接口获取任务明细ID

AccessDeniedDetail.description_en: The details of the access denial

CallResult.description_en:
The call result. Valid values:

`CALL_FORWARDING`: Call forwarding.

`INCOMING_CALL_BARRED`: Incoming call barred.

`CALL_REJECTED`: Call rejected.

`ANSWERED`: Answered by user.

`USER_BUSY`: Called party busy.

`POWERED_OFF`: Powered off.

`NO_USER_RESPONSE`: Out of service area.

`OPERATOR_BLOCK`: Blocked by carrier.

`OTHERS`: Other.

`SUSPEND`: Suspended.

`CANCEL`: Canceled by caller.

`INVALID_NUMBER`: Invalid number.

`UNAVAILABLE`: Temporarily unavailable.

`NETWORK_BUSY`: Network busy.

`NO_ANSWER`: No answer
CallResult.description_zh:
呼叫结果。取值：
CALL_FORWARDING：呼叫转移。
INCOMING_CALL_BARRED：限制呼入。
CALL_REJECTED：拒接。
ANSWERED：用户接通。
USER_BUSY：被叫忙。
POWERED_OFF：关机。
NO_USER_RESPONSE：不在服务区。
OPERATOR_BLOCK：运营商拦截。
OTHERS：其他状态。
SUSPEND：停机。
CANCEL：主叫取消。
INVALID_NUMBER：空号。
UNAVAILABLE：暂时无法接通。
NETWORK_BUSY：网络忙。
NO_ANSWER：无应答

HangupDirection.description_en:
The party that hung up. Valid values:

0: user.

1: assistant
HangupDirection.description_zh:
挂断方向。取值：

0：用户。
1：机器人

OutId.description_en: The business-specific ID that is passed in. You can use this unique ID to associate the call with your business
OutId.description_zh: 外部传入的业务流水号，可用唯一ID做业务关联
